text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Hyacinth Stakes kicks off...!! 
Umamusume are as precious as ever today~♪ 
Wait, doesn't the atmosphere feel way more 
intense than usual...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Could there be something even purer behind 
this blessedness? Hmmm, allow me to gaze 
upon its true nature! Just a little bit 
closer than before!
